headline: Top 25 citizen complaints this week in Austin

items.text: I was unable to walk my dog this morning because CHAMP and WISDOM chased us (barking aggressively) until I was safely home. They belong to Olivia N. who live on Walnut Grove. I have over 25 service trackings made over the last two years regarding this issue, and it still hasn't been resolved to make it safe to walk my dog in my own neighborhood. Many neighbors have offered help, but the own ALLOWS

Luna freaking rooftop bar is so god d*** loud it woke me up from my sleep. It sounded like someone was banging on my window from the bass. Some people have actual jobs that require them to wake up early. Can this city do its job and enforce the noise statures for once???
please help!!! lots of buses coming and car is blocking tour bus lane/ tow zone ..this is about to be a major safety issue

this dog has been loose for a week in pioneer crossing west. several people report this dog snd then he goes home. then loose the next day. his name is cyclone and owner is Adrian Lopez. hes not taking care of the dog snd needs a new home. this dog will eventually get hit or die of heat stroke. please do something about this. several people reported this dog loose. the owner is not fit to own a do

Very loud disruptive amplified music coming from Barrett’s Too at 103 N Loop Blvd. Stage backs up to multiple residential properties and is less than 100 feet away from homes. They do not have an OMV permit. Please send a code enforcement officer.

Ran up to me and my dogs on our daily walk and attempted to attack my dogs AGAIN. Both then ran into traffic. This is my 3rd report. They have repeatedly come after me and my dogs on our morning walks. They have repeatedly run into traffic. A previous instance was so aggressive, a car passing by tried to run them over to help me.

I am requesting maintenance for the city-owned park land located at 5503 Bennett Ave, Austin, TX. The lot is significantly overgrown with tall grass, weeds, and/or vegetation that has not been maintained. As a city-owned property, this land should be regularly mowed and kept clear in accordance with city maintenance standards. Please schedule a crew to mow and clear the overgrowth at this location

The construction site at 4816 Aberdeen is messy and dangerous.  Not only is the sidewalk covered with dirt and stones from the day’s work (it is not swept at the end of the work day), now the stacked lumber is well into the sidewalk.  This is not ADA compliant, nor is it basic user-friendly for the many neighbors who walk on this street.

Both left turn lanes from WB290 to William Canon have been blocked all weekend and now into the week. It is causing major backup and folks are dangerously weaving through the construction barrels and intersection, as there is no better way through. The lane signage is inaccurate and makes the problem worse.

Massive amounts of trash appears to be former and active homeless encampment. Extreme impact to environmental greenbelt.  Area above Walnut Creek watershed.  Major impact to natural waterway.  Notice of removal posted no action taken or encampment has been reoccupied.

Fence is badly damaged. Higher fence needs to be installed around the basketball court to prevent the ball from bouncing over the fence and down the hill. People run into and damage this fence due to it being too low to catch the basketball so they run to try to catch it before it bounces over and down the hill.

Encampment - They have not cleaned this encampment since February. We were told and a sign was posted stating they would come out every 30 days. The grass needs cutting and they are tents, sofas, bikes, carts and trash everywhere. Several men living down there walking up and down the streets all night with items they gave stolen from people.

This pile of trash and junk has been growing for five weeks or more at 6708 Krollton, Austin 78745. The house is vacant and seemingly abandoned. The home sits on a corner lot — the pile itself is located on Campden Dr. and spills into the street. It needs to be hauled away.

At 1409 Ridgehaven Dr, 78723 my neighbor is not living here currently and the property/yard is in bad shape, attracting ticks, critters, etc. I need the property owner to clean this up. Also parts of his roof are coming off in the back on windy days. A fox lives back there and stray cats bring fleas.

There is a large pothole forming on West Ave in the southbound lane right where 7th St comes into it. West Ave surfacec was redone in front of Cirrus Logic, but this is just north of it. A new "slow down" street barrier was just installed nearby which makes traffic drive directly over it. This pothole is getting worse and will be losing pavement and turning into a real hole soon. Needs a good deep

Completed. Hello, the traffice light at 290/Giles lane seems to be off. Coming 290 south/east and turning under the overpass, the light is green for a few seconds, turns red for a few seconds, then green again. This disrupts traffic flow and has already caused a few near hits. Please review. Thank you.

items.text: Creek bed behind 7629 Rockpoint Dr Austin 78731 has blocked water flow due to several fallen tree’s. Austin Watershed was notified on May 26,2026 on service request # 26-00164680. Complete removal and clearing off all tree’s, limbs and debris needs to be cleared immediately as future flooding is very likely.

3 photos (2 on the right are the same tree- a bur oak)of young trees recently planted at Shipe Park, along Avenue F side. Either the sprinkler system is turned off or not functioning.  Older established trees are fine for now,  but the burr oak was  just planted last winter. With the weather getting hotter, we don’t want to lose these trees.

On this corner of North Loop and Guadalupe, there’s a ton of overgrowth on the property that is contributing to the high number of traffic accidents we’re seeing at this intersection the past few months. You can’t see the cars coming from Lamar if you’re driving north on Guadalupe, or the cars coming from Guadalupe if you’re driving east on North Loop.
